about: M9 key (T19), written before any re-anchor code. cases: every candidate pair produced mechanically by bench/m9-key-builder.ts (TS/TSX function, const-arrow, class and method symbols whose name disappears from a commit's touched files paired with same-kind symbols whose name appears: same file, git -M renamed file, or another touched file when the token Jaccard >= 0.5), from the Mole repo history and the Excalidraw clone (250 commits). Each pair was then LABELLED BY HAND from reading the diff (label + reason): rename = same symbol, new name, body same; rename+change = same symbol renamed and edited (callers switched to it, or its code is the clear bulk of the new symbol); not-rename = different symbols (new helper, split, merge into a generalized function, small placeholder bodies). Labels are not produced by the re-anchor algorithm. synthetic: planted fixtures (counted separately in the bench), including the ambiguous cases.
labelRules: rename: same role, callers (if any) now use the new name, normalized body identical except the symbol's own name
rename+change: same role continued under a new name (callers switched, or the old code is the clear bulk of the new symbol) and the body was edited
not-rename: the old symbol was dropped, split across several new symbols, or merged with another into one generalized symbol (no single successor), or the bodies are too small to tell

thresholds.similarity: Dice coefficient over token bigrams: TypeScript tokens of the declaration with trivia removed, the symbol's own name replaced by $SELF and (methods) its class name by $CLS
thresholds.note: fixed before the re-anchor code was written; similarity >= renamedChangedMin (and not identical) = renamed + changed (stale); identical normalized tokens = renamed (fresh); two best candidates within tieEpsilon after neighbor tie-breaks = ambiguous; declarations under minTokens tokens never re-anchor on body alone

scoring: per old symbol: expected = its rename / rename+change pair if any, else none. right = re-anchored to the labelled symbol with the labelled outcome (rename -> renamed/fresh, rename+change -> renamed+changed/stale). wrong = re-anchored to any other symbol, or re-anchored when expected none. silentFresh = rename+change reported as renamed (fresh). Target: right >= 95% of expected re-anchors (real cases), wrong = 0, silentFresh = 0; synthetic must be all right.
